release: Gem Pack Vol. 1-7, Black Bolt / White Flare and Collection 151 (Simplified Chinese) · art 5
note: Four things are modelled rather than measured. The Gem Pack ladder uses the publisher's ratio table (★ 17.39%, ★★ 5.80%, ★★★ 1.81%; ● and ◆ take the remainder), printed for Vols. 6 and 7 and applied to 1-5 as the line's figure. Black Bolt and White Flare use their own spec sheet (13.23%, 6.04%, 0.73% of cards dealt); Collection 151 publishes no spec sheet, so its ladder (90% commons and uncommons, 8% Rares and Double Rares, 1.5% higher) is a third-party count and is labelled one. No Chinese card in any of these lines has a recorded sale, so every value is anchored to the same card's English printing — the cheapest plain listing, which is an upper bound on what the Chinese copy trades at — and each line is scaled down where those values would put a five-card pack above 85% of its ¥10 sticker: Black Bolt ×0.226, White Flare ×0.272 and Collection 151 ×0.589. Black Bolt and White Flare carry the card lists Bulbapedia publishes (171 and 172 cards after Victini's unsupported Black White Rare entry is dropped, against the Chinese release's 174), with the tail numbered as the cards print: both China-only Special Illustration Rares at 173/086 and Zekrom ex and Reshiram ex at 174/086. Collection 151 uses the full 192-card list through the fourth booster, Gather; the April 2025 list of 186 is that set before Scare and Gather added three Pikachu art rares and three SARs, and Pokecottage's 465 counts reverse and Poké Ball/Master Ball variants of the same cards. Every picture these cards show is an English print's scan, because no Simplified Chinese set is in the catalogue's image service: the body of each set is the same printing at the same number, a renumbered card is the same card at its English number, the China-only Shiny Rares borrow shiny printings of the same Pokémon, the Gem Packs and the four Pikachu art rares borrow other printings of that name, and the fourteen Captain Pikachu cards have no English print at all and keep the placeholder. The set logos and symbols are the English sets'.
